resolution.reason: Independently rereviewed amended frozen specification adds no-follow conservative bare repository marker refusal; original specification preserved

findings.title: The external-parent rule checks only ancestor .git markers and therefore does not establish that the parent is outside a bare repository. A bare repository can have HEAD and objects/commondir without a .git marker; fixture Git discovery can then differ from the required non-repository semantics. Reject bare-repository structures without following their marker paths and explicitly cover bare roots and descendants, while retaining the existing minimal environment without GIT_DIR.

resolution.reason: Independently rereviewed amended specification separates initial rejection from execution drift and requires pre-pytest refusal with native local FAILED and CI read-only ledger

findings.title: Acceptance condition 3 promises zero writes for both initial invalid inputs and execution-time identity/leaf conflicts, but the proposed container creation and prelaunch guard occur after native subject sync, verifier-context saving and the VERIFYING transition. Late drift cannot erase those prior writes, and an uncaught guard error can leave VERIFYING without a terminal failure. Require initial parameter/container checks before writes; separately require late create/drift rejection before pytest launch, preservation of old contents and necessary current-run failure records, with service handling guard errors through a native FAILED transition.

summary: Independent design review of frozen spec 978cc68691f8ca65110def4ba455adc111eefeb24abc2b1b8ed88207e0c9c0d5, native regenerated context, task/classification bindings, and existing CLI, plan, process runner, verifier/evidence/finalization interfaces. The optional external-root approach can preserve unchanged Policy validation, default argv/environment, deduplication and evidence snapshot binding without adding runtime values to verifier context. Two design gaps require refreezing: bare repository discovery and the distinction between initial zero-write refusals and execution-time drift/failure recording. Reviewer has not implemented production or tests. No proposed implementation, bare-repository reproduction or complete V2 was executed; this is a design recommendation only.
